user.title: Create a link
user.description: Pick the entities that should mirror each other. Turning any of them on or off turns all of them on or off.

data.name: Name
data.triggers: Push buttons (optional, each press toggles the link)

data.event_types: Event types that toggle (event entities only)

data_description.primary: The entity wired to the physical load. Its state wins at startup and when it reconnects.
data_description.debounce_ms: Wait this long before propagating, to absorb devices that bounce (on→off→on). 0 propagates immediately.
data_description.event_types: For event entities, only these event types toggle the link (e.g. press, single). Empty = any event.

error.no_members: Pick at least one entity with an on/off state.
error.too_few: A link needs at least two entities in total.
error.already_linked: One of the entities already belongs to another link. Linking it twice could cause loops.
